transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic to see me today?

Hello. Well, I decided to come in because... honestly, I've been having some thoughts lately that scared me enough to finally ask for help. I just keep having these mornings where I wake up and think that it might be easier if I didn't wake up at all. 

I want to be clear that I don't have any sort of plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But just having those kinds of thoughts cross my mind... it made me realize I needed to come in and talk to someone.
Aside from these morning thoughts, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless throughout the day?

Not really, no. I mean, once I actually get up and get moving, the rest of the day is... well, it's mostly fine. I don't really walk around feeling sad or hopeless all afternoon. It's just that initial waking up part that hits me so hard. After I get past that, I just go about my normal routine.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?

Yes, I have noticed that. I mean, I still make myself show up for things, like my book club or the dance night. But lately... I just sit there feeling like I'm behind a pane of glass. I'm present, but I'm not really enjoying it. 

And even the things I do at home, like tending to my garden or cooking for the neighbors—they just don't give me that little lift they used to. I go through the motions, but the pleasure just isn't quite there right now.
About how long have you been experiencing this lack of enjoyment and those thoughts in the morning?

I'd say it's been going on for about a month now. It started right after my sister passed away... it was very unexpected. So, yeah, it's been about four weeks of waking up like this and just not enjoying things.
How has your sleep been over this past month?

Well, it hasn't been very good. I seem to fall asleep in bits and pieces at first... and then I wake up way before dawn. Once I'm awake, my mind is already turning, and I usually just can't get settled again before the day actually starts.
Have you ever experienced a period in your past where you felt this way, with low mood, loss of interest, or sleep trouble?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had sad days before, like anyone else, but... never a whole stretch of time where I felt quite like this. I've always been a pretty steady person, and usually a very good sleeper, too. So, no, I haven't ever gone through a period like this before.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your energy levels, such as feeling exhausted or lacking energy throughout the day?

Yes, I have. It's... well, even simple errands just leave me feeling completely worn out. Just doing basic things, like getting some papers together for the Cultural Center, it takes so much out of me now. It honestly feels like my body is just moving through thick mud.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over the past month?

Yes, I suppose I have. Food just doesn't... call to me much anymore. I'll fix myself a little toast or maybe some soup, and then I'll realize by the evening that I've barely eaten anything all day. I'm certainly not trying to lose weight or anything like that, it's just... the desire to eat isn't really there right now.
Have you found yourself struggling with feelings of worthlessness or blaming yourself excessively for things?

Yes, I do. I just... I keep going over those last few weeks with my sister. I find myself constantly thinking I should have called her more, or listened better... just done something more useful. A part of me knows logically that I couldn't have changed what happened, but I still can't stop blaming myself for not doing more.
